findings.claim: Ausbruch sits between Beerenauslese and Trockenbeerenauslese on the Austrian must-weight ladder, and its name comes from breaking the shrivelled berries out of the bunch.
findings.finalFix: Ausbruch once sat between Beerenauslese and Trockenbeerenauslese on the Austrian must-weight ladder; today the name belongs to Rust alone and requires Trockenbeerenauslese must weight (30 KMW). The name comes from breaking the shrivelled berries out of the bunch.
